verdict.line: You lose if Garen lands Q (Decisive Strike) into a full E (Judgment) combo before you have W (Path Maker) to answer it; you win by baiting his Q on cooldown and out-scaling with item haste into All Out.

brief.thesis: K'Sante's kit is built to interrupt and disengage an all-in, but Garen's Q (Decisive Strike) silences on hit, which shuts down your W stun and E shield the instant it lands. The lane is decided by whether you trade when his Q is down (8s cooldown) and whether you poke him enough to deny his passive Perseverance regen between fights.

theirWindow.when: his Q (Decisive Strike) is up and he closes
theirWindow.what: If Q lands it silences you, removing W (Path Maker) and E (Footwork) from the trade. Don't commit into a fresh Q — bait it with Q (Ntofo Strikes) poke from range first.

yourWindow.what: Without the silence threat, stack Q (Ntofo Strikes) for the 2-stack shockwave pull and follow with W (Path Maker) stun for a full trade he can't answer.

powerCurve.note: Garen's Q-E all-in hits hard, you lack W
W online, Q stacks let you trade back
R execute looms but low uptime early
Item spikes and W haste win extended trades
All Out burst outpaces his passive sustain

start.why: The passive regen and reduced damage from champion hits blunt Garen's early Q-E poke and autoattack trades.

boots.why: Garen's damage is entirely physical autoattacks and E (Judgment), which is an AA-reliant spin — flat reduction against both.

core.why: Gives HP and AD for early trades and rewards landing your empowered hits in short exchanges.
The health and burn aura punishes a low-mobility, close-range fighter like Garen every time he stays in range.
Cuts the value of any attack speed or crit Garen builds, and the active slows him when he tries to stick to you.

situational.when: he builds lifesteal or you need Grievous Wounds to cut his passive Perseverance regen
their team adds meaningful magic damage alongside Garen
you need more gap-close to punish his cooldowns instead of pure durability

runes.keystoneWhy: The bonus health and proc heal win extended trades against a champion with no hard CC to punish you for standing in melee range.

summoners.why: Flash keeps you safe from a Q (Decisive Strike) silence chaining into a full all-in, and Teleport lets you reset waves and join fights once your item spikes online.

playing.title: Bait Q before committing
playing.detail: Poke with Q (Ntofo Strikes) from max range and wait for Garen to throw Decisive Strike before you walk up for a real trade — landing it silences your W and E.

playing.title: Stack for the shockwave pull
playing.detail: Two Q (Ntofo Strikes) hits fire a shockwave that pulls Garen in — use this to lock him down for W (Path Maker) instead of chasing manually.

playing.title: Interrupt his all-in with W
playing.detail: W (Path Maker) knocks back and stuns, which cancels his E (Judgment) spin mid-cast if you time the dash as he commits.

playing.title: Deny his passive between trades
playing.detail: Perseverance heals him back if he avoids damage — land a Q (Ntofo Strikes) poke on your way back to lane or on recall timers to keep him from resetting to full.

playing.title: Play around his R at low health
playing.detail: Demacian Justice is a percent-health execute once he hits level 6 (140/110/80/50/20s cooldown) — don't sit at low HP near him without E (Footwork) shield or Flash ready.

playing.title: Time All Out after his cooldowns are down
playing.detail: Pop R (All Out) once his Q and E are both spent so he can't silence or spin through your transformed combo, and finish before his passive regen can offset your damage.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names shift patch to patch — confirm Sundered Sky, Sunfire Aegis, and Randuin's Omen are still live under those names, and check Resolve tree rune slots (Demolish/Bone Plating/Overgrowth) haven't been reworked before locking runes.
